Population Raster Reprojection to Web Mercator The WorldPop 2026 population Raster was reprojected from WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) to Web Mercator (EPSG:3857). Sum resampling was used because source values represent estimated population per grid cell. The output is intended for web-map alignment, not for distance or area measurement. The displayed layer is an aggregated copy; the saved GeoTIFF retains the target grid.
